question: Should `/workspace` become a supported alias in full gateway/CLI containers, or remain reserved for sandbox workspace semantics?
rationale: Current code and docs deliberately expose different paths for runtime persistence and sandbox tool workspaces; choosing an alias changes the user-facing container contract across multiple installation paths.

options.title: Support the runtime alias
options.body: Add and test a single `/workspace -> /home/node/.openclaw/workspace` contract across the image and supported Docker/Podman setup paths.

options.title: Keep `/workspace` sandbox-only
options.body: Retain the canonical runtime path and make the sandbox-versus-runtime distinction explicit in container and workspace guidance.

recommendation.title: Keep `/workspace` sandbox-only
recommendation.body: Retain the canonical runtime path and make the sandbox-versus-runtime distinction explicit in container and workspace guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing discussion and feature-history evidence connect this person to the container and sandbox path boundary at issue.
